Court No. - 78
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 19551 of 2024

Applicant :- Rahul Shashtri
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

Counsel for Applicant :- Ashwini Kumar Ojha
Counsel for Opposite Party :- Amit Daga,G.A.
Hon'ble Mayank Kumar Jain,J.
Supplementary affidavit filed today by learned counsel for the applicant is taken on record.
Heard Sri Ashwini Kumar Ojha, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Amit Daga, learned counsel for the informant and learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

The present bail application has been filed on behalf of applicant in S.T.No. 251 of 2018, arising out of Case Crime No. 286 of 2018, under Sections 498A, 304B, 504, 120B of IPC and 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Babina, District Jhansi with the prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail.
First and second bail application was rejected by this Court vide orders dated 16.07.2019 and 18.05.2023 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application Nos. 28232 of 2019 and 9961 of 2021 respectively.

sentences.text: It is submitted that the order of this Court for expeditious disposal of the Session Trial was filed before the Court on 26.06.2023.
The evidence of prosecution have been concluded and the statement of the applicant under Section 313 Cr.P.C has also been recorded.
On behalf of the applicant, six defence witnesses have been recorded.
The applicant moved an application for expert opinion about the hand writing of his wife relating to the letters written by her.
That report is still awaited.
Learned counsel for the applicant placed reliance on the judgement passed by the Hon'ble Apex Court in Phulel Singh Vs. State of Haryana, 2023 LawSuit (SC) 951.

entities.text: Phulel Singh Vs. State of Haryana, 2023 LawSuit (SC) 951
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Per contra, the learned A.G.A and Sri Amit Daga, learned counsel for the informant have opposed the prayer for grant of bail and submitted that there is no delay on the part of the Court.
The Court is trying its best to conclude the trial within the time given by this Court.
The order sheet of the Court reflects that direction of this Court finds place in it.
It is the applicant who is moving regular application for summoning of the witnesses and seeking expert opinion.

Considering the entire facts and circumstances of the case, submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of evidence and gravity of the offence, without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, the Court is of the view that the applicant is not entitled for the bail, therefore, the bail application is rejected.
Any observation made above shall not be treated as any finding on the merit and shall not prejudice the trial.

Order Date :- 4.6.2024 PS  Rahul Shashtri vs State Of U.P. on 4 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/84000586/
